headline: Union Pacific (UNP) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Higher Analyst Targets
summary: Union Pacific’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$299.83 to US$327.75, a move of about 9.3% that reframes how some analysts are thinking about the stock today. Recent research has leaned toward higher price targets and mostly positive views on execution, even as a few firms focus more on valuation questions and potential deal risk around the Norfolk Southern proposal.
